THE MORE I STUDY base:0xc6405d7a226e1c18e559be2f335f74c01ad07bf5, THE MORE I THINK ITS BIGGEST ADVANTAGE IS BEING OVERLOOKED.

Stockify doesn’t necessarily need to pick the winning memestock.

It doesn’t even necessarily need to pick the winning launchpad.

That’s the part I find fascinating.

Think about the difference:

base:0xe34356dcd3d7bb991248f322e4ec31b5d60bc54e needs DGUY to win.

$TEMU needs TEMU to win.

A launchpad generally needs its own launches to win.

Stockify can potentially benefit when MANY different projects win.

Why?

Because the infrastructure is launchpad-agnostic.

A project can route its creator-fee stream into Stockify infrastructure and use it to:

→ buy tokenized stocks for holders
→ build a weighted asset basket
→ buy back and burn a token

Stonks is using this infrastructure today.
But Stockify itself is not conceptually locked to Stonks.

Another supported launchpad can plug into the same system.

THAT is what starts making this look less like another crypto token…

and more like financial middleware.

And I still haven’t found a direct horizontal competitor on Base offering this same combination:

stock rewards

configurable baskets

buyback/burn infrastructure

launchpad independence

There are launchpads with their own internal reward systems.

That’s different.

Those are vertical.

Stockify is trying to sit underneath the entire market.

And after yesterday’s discovery, we now know why that matters even more:

if Stockify infrastructure adoption grows, at least some of that external economic activity can feed back into base:0xc6405d7a226e1c18e559be2f335f74c01ad07bf5 itself.

So the bet becomes much bigger than:

“Will STFY trade more?”

The question becomes:

“How much economic activity can eventually run THROUGH Stockify?”

That is a very different TAM.

And IMO there is one thing holding base:0xc6405d7a226e1c18e559be2f335f74c01ad07bf5 back right now more than anything else:

SURFACING.

The product exists.

The integrations exist.

The tokenomics are much stronger than I originally understood.

What it does NOT have yet is enough people looking at it.

Sometimes crypto has a product problem.

Sometimes it has a tokenomics problem.

I think Stockify currently has a DISCOVERY problem.

And those can resolve very differently.

top_posts.translation_zh:
我越研究 base:0xc6405d7a226e1c18e559be2f335f74c01ad07bf5，就越觉得它最大的优势被忽视了。

Stockify 不一定需要选中胜出的 memestock。

它甚至也不一定需要选中胜出的 launchpad。

这就是我觉得很有意思的部分。

想想其中的区别：

base:0xe34356dcd3d7bb991248f322e4ec31b5d60bc54e 需要 DGUY 胜出。

$TEMU 需要 TEMU 胜出。

一个 launchpad 通常需要它自己推出的项目胜出。

Stockify 可能在许多不同项目胜出时都受益。

为什么？

因为这个基础设施是 launchpad 无关的。

一个项目可以把它的创作者费用流导入 Stockify 基础设施，并用它来：

→ 为持有者购买代币化股票
→ 构建加权资产篮子
→ 回购并销毁一个代币

Stonks 目前正在使用这套基础设施。
但 Stockify 本身在概念上并没有被锁定在 Stonks 上。

另一个受支持的 launchpad 可以接入同一个系统。

这正是让它开始看起来不太像又一个加密代币……

而更像是金融中间件的地方。

而且我仍然没有在 Base 上找到一个直接的横向竞争对手，能提供同样的组合：

股票奖励

可配置的篮子

回购/销毁基础设施

launchpad 独立性

有些 launchpad 有自己的内部奖励系统。

那不一样。

那些是垂直的。

Stockify 试图位于整个市场的底层。

在昨天的发现之后，我们现在知道这为什么更加重要：

如果 Stockify 基础设施的采用率增长，至少其中一部分外部经济活动可以反哺到 base:0xc6405d7a226e1c18e559be2f335f74c01ad07bf5 本身。

所以这个押注就变得远不止：

“STFY 会交易得更多吗？”

问题变成了：

“最终能有多少经济活动通过 Stockify 运行？”

这是一个非常不同的 TAM。

而在我看来，目前最拖累 base:0xc6405d7a226e1c18e559be2f335f74c01ad07bf5 的一件事，胜过其他任何因素：

曝光。

产品已经存在。

集成已经存在。

代币经济学比我最初理解的要强得多。

它目前还没有的是足够多的人关注它。

有时候，加密项目存在产品问题。

有时候，它存在代币经济学问题。

我认为 Stockify 目前存在的是发现问题。

而这类问题的解决方式可能非常不同。

THE MORE I STUDY base:0xc6405d7a226e1c18e559be2f335f74c01ad07bf5, THE MORE I THINK ITS BIGGEST ADVANTAGE IS BEING OVERLOOKED.

Stockify doesn’t necessarily need to pick the winning memestock.

It doesn’t even necessarily need to pick the winning launchpad.

That’s the part I find fascinating.

Think about the difference:

base:0xe34356dcd3d7bb991248f322e4ec31b5d60bc54e needs DGUY to win.

$TEMU needs TEMU to win.

A launchpad generally needs its own launches to win.

Stockify can potentially benefit when MANY different projects win.

Why?

Because the infrastructure is launchpad-agnostic.

A project can route its creator-fee stream into Stockify infrastructure and use it to:

→ buy tokenized stocks for holders
→ build a weighted asset basket
→ buy back and burn a token

Stonks is using this infrastructure today.
But Stockify itself is not conceptually locked to Stonks.

Another supported launchpad can plug into the same system.

THAT is what starts making this look less like another crypto token…

and more like financial middleware.

And I still haven’t found a direct horizontal competitor on Base offering this same combination:

stock rewards

configurable baskets

buyback/burn infrastructure

launchpad independence

There are launchpads with their own internal reward systems.

That’s different.

Those are vertical.

Stockify is trying to sit underneath the entire market.

And after yesterday’s discovery, we now know why that matters even more:

if Stockify infrastructure adoption grows, at least some of that external economic activity can feed back into base:0xc6405d7a226e1c18e559be2f335f74c01ad07bf5 itself.

So the bet becomes much bigger than:

“Will STFY trade more?”

The question becomes:

“How much economic activity can eventually run THROUGH Stockify?”

That is a very different TAM.

And IMO there is one thing holding base:0xc6405d7a226e1c18e559be2f335f74c01ad07bf5 back right now more than anything else:

SURFACING.

The product exists.

The integrations exist.

The tokenomics are much stronger than I originally understood.

What it does NOT have yet is enough people looking at it.

Sometimes crypto has a product problem.

Sometimes it has a tokenomics problem.

I think Stockify currently has a DISCOVERY problem.

And those can resolve very differently.

effective_posts.translation_zh:
我越研究 base:0xc6405d7a226e1c18e559be2f335f74c01ad07bf5，就越觉得它最大的优势被忽视了。

Stockify 不一定需要选中胜出的 memestock。

它甚至也不一定需要选中胜出的 launchpad。

这就是我觉得很有意思的部分。

想想其中的区别：

base:0xe34356dcd3d7bb991248f322e4ec31b5d60bc54e 需要 DGUY 胜出。

$TEMU 需要 TEMU 胜出。

一个 launchpad 通常需要它自己推出的项目胜出。

Stockify 可能在许多不同项目胜出时都受益。

为什么？

因为这个基础设施是 launchpad 无关的。

一个项目可以把它的创作者费用流导入 Stockify 基础设施，并用它来：

→ 为持有者购买代币化股票
→ 构建加权资产篮子
→ 回购并销毁一个代币

Stonks 目前正在使用这套基础设施。
但 Stockify 本身在概念上并没有被锁定在 Stonks 上。

另一个受支持的 launchpad 可以接入同一个系统。

这正是让它开始看起来不太像又一个加密代币……

而更像是金融中间件的地方。

而且我仍然没有在 Base 上找到一个直接的横向竞争对手，能提供同样的组合：

股票奖励

可配置的篮子

回购/销毁基础设施

launchpad 独立性

有些 launchpad 有自己的内部奖励系统。

那不一样。

那些是垂直的。

Stockify 试图位于整个市场的底层。

在昨天的发现之后，我们现在知道这为什么更加重要：

如果 Stockify 基础设施的采用率增长，至少其中一部分外部经济活动可以反哺到 base:0xc6405d7a226e1c18e559be2f335f74c01ad07bf5 本身。

所以这个押注就变得远不止：

“STFY 会交易得更多吗？”

问题变成了：

“最终能有多少经济活动通过 Stockify 运行？”

这是一个非常不同的 TAM。

而在我看来，目前最拖累 base:0xc6405d7a226e1c18e559be2f335f74c01ad07bf5 的一件事，胜过其他任何因素：

曝光。

产品已经存在。

集成已经存在。

代币经济学比我最初理解的要强得多。

它目前还没有的是足够多的人关注它。

有时候，加密项目存在产品问题。

有时候，它存在代币经济学问题。

我认为 Stockify 目前存在的是发现问题。

而这类问题的解决方式可能非常不同。
